Some messages, she decided, were not requests for answers; they were reasons to keep going.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时调低声音的机器。高楼的窗大多暗着，只有零星灯火浮在玻璃深处；便利店亮得过分清白，店员把热饮递给刚下班的人。环卫车缓缓转过路口，水龙头在街角轻响。第一班公交载着几个沉默的影子，穿过潮湿的路面。远处天边泛起一线灰蓝，早餐铺掀开卷帘门，蒸汽升起来，像城市尚未说出的梦。","w03":"• Recursion is when something uses a smaller version of itself to get a job done.\n• Imagine opening a box and finding another box inside; you keep opening smaller boxes until you reach the toy.\n• A recursive recipe says what to do with each box and when to stop, so it doesn’t go on forever."}
